subject: Kickoff: Felix assisted-rewrite track
body:
Team — kicking off the Felix track.

The approach decomposes text editing into tagging (choose and order the input tokens to keep) and insertion (in-fill the missing tokens with a bi-directional model), which makes it a strong fit for the assisted-rewrite feature language wants: edits stay close to the user's own words, unlike free generation.

Plan for the window: (1) reproduce the DiscoFuse sentence-fusion pipeline end-to-end — label map construction, data conversion, fine-tuning both models — by Mar 6; (2) adapt to our internal rewrite corpus by early April; (3) quality evaluation, including human ratings, through April; (4) launch-review pre-read by May 8.

Tereza owns modeling, Fumiko evaluation, Maren the data pipeline. Bao follows up on staffing and eval logistics.

Priya
